description: Export the document as an interactive PDF with buttons, forms, media, hyperlinks and page transitions, setting any option of the Export to Interactive PDF dialog (File > Export > Adobe PDF (Interactive))

filePath.description: Output PDF file path (inside the allowed directories)

keepSettings.description: Leave the settings in place after the export, as the dialog does (default: put the previous settings back)

defaultDocumentLanguage.description: Language, as InDesign names it, e.g. "English: USA"

exportReaderSpreads.description: Export spreads instead of pages (Pages / Spreads)

flipPages.description: Presentation: Flip Pages Every few seconds

interactivePDFInteractiveElementsOption.description: Forms and Media: include all, or appearance only

openInFullScreen.description: Presentation: Open in Full Screen Mode

singlePagesPDFSuffix.description: File name suffix for separate PDF files

pages.description: Pages: "all", or page names as in the Pages panel such as "1-3,5"; prefix + for absolute positions ("+1-+3")

name: export_interactive_pdf
title: Export Interactive PDF
